achievements.name: Starstruck
achievements.summary: Created a repository that has many stars.
achievements.unit: stars on one repository you own

achievements.name: Pull Shark
achievements.summary: Opened pull requests that have been merged.

achievements.name: Pair Extraordinaire
achievements.summary: Coauthored commits on merged pull requests.
achievements.unit: merged pull requests with a coauthored commit

achievements.name: Galaxy Brain
achievements.summary: Answered discussions that were marked as the accepted answer.

achievements.name: Quickdraw
achievements.summary: Closed an issue or pull request within 5 minutes of opening it.

achievements.name: YOLO
achievements.summary: Merged a pull request without a code review.

achievements.name: Public Sponsor
achievements.summary: Sponsored an open source contributor through GitHub Sponsors.

achievements.name: Arctic Code Vault Contributor
achievements.summary: Contributed code to repositories in the 2020 GitHub Archive Program.

achievements.name: Mars 2020 Helicopter Contributor
achievements.summary: Contributed code to repositories used in the Mars 2020 Helicopter Mission.

achievements.name: Heart On Your Sleeve
achievements.summary: Spotted in GitHub's code and tests, reportedly for reacting with a heart. Not awarded publicly.

achievements.name: Open Sourcerer
achievements.summary: Spotted in GitHub's code, reportedly for open source contributions. Not awarded publicly.

highlights.name: PRO
highlights.summary: Shown while your account is on the GitHub Pro plan (also shown for Education/Student Developer Pack users who get Pro).

highlights.name: Developer Program Member
highlights.summary: Shown after you join the GitHub Developer Program (you must have built or be building something that integrates with GitHub).

highlights.name: Security Bug Bounty Hunter
highlights.summary: Shown after you report an eligible vulnerability through the GitHub Security Bug Bounty program on HackerOne.

highlights.name: GitHub Campus Expert
highlights.summary: Shown for students accepted into the GitHub Campus Expert program.

highlights.name: Security Advisory Credit
highlights.summary: Shown when you are credited on a reviewed advisory in the GitHub Advisory Database.

highlights.name: GitHub Star
highlights.summary: Shown for members of the GitHub Stars program, which is by nomination for community leaders.
